hints.title: BUILD SPEED
hints.body: Run and {JUMP} to move. At speed, {SLIDE} for a burst. Speed is power: the faster you go, the harder you hit.

hints.title: HOOK AND FLING
hints.body: Jump, then hold {HOOK} to latch onto the block above and swing. Let go at the bottom of the swing to fling: you fly farther than any jump.

hints.title: SPEED TIERS
hints.body: Your speed sets your tier (1-3): higher tiers hit harder. Brutes are armoured below tier 3. Fling or chain kills to reach it.

hints.title: WALL JUMP
hints.body: Jump into a wall, then {JUMP} again to kick off it. Hook the ledges above to climb fast.

hints.title: THE RAIL
hints.body: The overpass underside is one long anchor. Swing, let go, {HOOK} again ahead: chain swings, then fling off the end.

hints.title: THE GALLERY
hints.body: Spikes below, chandeliers above. Hook one, release forward, hook the next: chain the swings, or hop the safe islands.

hints.title: GRUNT
hints.body: Dies to any hit with {ATTACK}. Each kill gives speed back; kill again quickly to chain for more.

hints.title: BRUTE
hints.body: Armoured below tier 3: hit it at full speed. When it charges, dodge so it crashes into a wall: dazed, armour down.

hints.title: DRONE
hints.body: Hovers out of reach, holds still, then dives at you. Dodge the dive and strike it while it is low.

hints.title: SHOOTER
hints.body: Fires after a wind-up. {ATTACK} its shot to reflect it back. A hit during the wind-up cancels the shot.

hints.title: SHIELD
hints.body: Its shield blocks strikes from the front. Hit it from behind or from above; it turns slowly.

hints.title: KAMIKAZE
hints.body: Rushes you and lights a fuse. Kill it before the fuse ends, or get clear. The blast hurts enemies too.

hints.title: SUMMONER
hints.body: Runs away and summons drones until it dies. Chase it down. A hit during its cast stops the summon.

hints.title: HEALTH ORB
hints.body: Restores health. Enemies sometimes drop orbs when they die; grab them before they fade.

hints.title: SPEED ORB
hints.body: For a while you run faster and your speed cap is higher: tier 3 comes easier.

hints.title: HOOK ORB
hints.body: For a while your hook has no cooldown and more range. Chain swings freely.
